description: This file implements core logic for detecting when files in a repository should be considered as 'broken' (e.g., renamed or significantly changed) during diff operations, specifically for Git's diffcore functionality. It includes algorithms for deciding whether to break file pairs based on edit distance, content changes, and size, as well as functions for breaking and merging file pairs accordingly.

methods.name: int should_break(struct repository * r,struct diff_filespec * src,struct diff_filespec * dst,int break_score,int * merge_score_p)
methods.description: Determines whether a file pair should be considered as broken based on size, content differences, and other heuristics. Returns 1 if the pair should be broken, otherwise 0.

methods.name: void diffcore_break(struct repository * r,int break_score)
methods.description: Splits large or significantly changed file pairs into delete/create pairs to facilitate accurate diffing and rename detection.

methods.name: void merge_broken(struct diff_filepair * p,struct diff_filepair * pp,struct diff_queue_struct * outq)
methods.description: Merges two broken file pairs back into a single pair when conditions indicate they are actually the same file or should be treated as such.

methods.name: void diffcore_merge_broken(void)
methods.description: Iterates through queued diff pairs and merges broken pairs back together if applicable.
